directories.description: The content of Folio Test — its document, chapters and blocks.
This instance's work plan — one Markdown file per bean, managed with the `beans` CLI (`.beans.yml`).
People's outstanding items and the feedback raised against blocks; its inner directories are declared by `todos/todos.json`.

The trashcan that is kept: deprecated and removed content, each node declaring itself `folio-fsh-guts/v1` with where it came from. Where a cutover deposits the directory it removes from main. Never rendered.
